description: What it does Bananaify is an all-in-one AI platform for image and video creation. Generate stunning visuals from text prompts, edit photos with AI, and create AI videos — all in one place. Powered by top AI models including Flux, GPT-Image, Kling, and Wan. Key benefits - Access multiple AI models in one platform — no need to switch between tools - Generate images from text with Flux, GPT-Image, and more - Create AI videos with Kling and Wan models - AI photo editing: remove backgrounds, upscale,
